title: Florida gov. candidate Byron Donalds responds after Trump mentions removed from site
description: Some prominent references to President Trump were scrubbed from Florida gubernatorial candidate Byron Donalds' campaign website in recent weeks, but the Republican said he isn't backing away from the president's agenda.

title: Hawaii is facing another hurricane watch as new storm closes in
description: Nolo is expected to become a hurricane sometime Thursday, and could become a major hurricane by the weekend as it approaches Hawaii's Big Island.

title: From a Nepal in Pain, a Young Leader Makes a Case for Climate Reparations
description: Balendra Shah, 36, comes to the U.N. as a sun-glassed symbol of Gen Z political power. But concerns about his style are growing at home after devastating floods left thousands dead or missing.

title: World Cup Star Could Bring Talents to NFL in Unprecedented Move
description: A worldwide soccer star wants to bring his skills to America and perhaps take on both types of football at once.
